tool_schemas.name: create_draft
tool_schemas.description: Creates a Gmail draft and returns the created draft resource; provide either a fully-formed RFC 2822 message as base64url in `raw` (which takes precedence and ignores `to`/`cc`/`bcc`/`subject`/`body`/`includeBodyHtml`), or provide structured fields to have the message composed for you, optionally associating it to `threadId`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `raw` is not valid base64url/RFC 2822, if recipient fields are not valid email address strings, or if `threadId` is malformed; raises NOT_FOUND if `threadId` is provided but the referenced thread does not exist. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the account is not connected or lacks Gmail draft scope, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if Gmail/API rate limits prevent creation.

raw.description: The entire email message in base64url encoded RFC 2822 format, ignores params.to, cc, bcc, subject, body, includeBodyHtml if provided

threadId.description: The thread ID to associate this draft with

cc.description: List of CC recipient email addresses

bcc.description: List of BCC recipient email addresses

includeBodyHtml.description: Whether to include the parsed HTML in the return for each body, excluded by default because they can be excessively large

tool_schemas.name: delete_draft
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the draft with the given ID and returns a confirmation of deletion. Raises NOT_FOUND if the draft ID does not exist or is not accessible to the authenticated user. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the account is not connected or lacks Gmail draft scope, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if rate limits prevent deletion.

id.description: The ID of the draft to delete

tool_schemas.name: get_draft
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single draft by ID and returns the draft resource, optionally including parsed HTML bodies when `includeBodyHtml` is true. Raises NOT_FOUND if the draft ID does not exist or is not accessible to the authenticated user. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the account is not connected or lacks Gmail read/draft scope, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if rate limits prevent retrieval.

id.description: The ID of the draft to retrieve

includeBodyHtml.description: Whether to include the parsed HTML in the return for each body, excluded by default because they can be excessively large

tool_schemas.name: list_drafts
tool_schemas.description: Lists drafts in the user’s mailbox and returns up to `maxResults` items (1–500), filtered by the Gmail search query `q` and optionally including drafts in SPAM/TRASH when `includeSpamTrash` is true; results are paged by the service using a continuation token returned with the page when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `maxResults` is outside 1–500 or if the query parameters are malformed. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the account is not connected or lacks Gmail read/draft scope, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if rate limits prevent listing.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of drafts to return. Accepts values between 1-500

q.description: Only return drafts matching the specified query. Supports the same query format as the Gmail search box

includeSpamTrash.description: Include drafts from SPAM and TRASH in the results

includeBodyHtml.description: Whether to include the parsed HTML in the return for each body, excluded by default because they can be excessively large

tool_schemas.name: send_draft
tool_schemas.description: Sends an existing draft and returns the sent message resource (and updates the draft state accordingly). Raises NOT_FOUND if the draft ID does not exist or is not accessible, and CONFLICT if the draft can’t be sent because it has already been sent/deleted or is otherwise not in a sendable state. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the account is not connected or lacks Gmail send scope, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if rate limits prevent sending.

id.description: The ID of the draft to send

tool_schemas.name: create_label
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new user label and returns the created label resource with its resolved visibility and optional color settings. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `name` is missing/empty, if visibility values are not one of the allowed enums, or if `color.textColor`/`color.backgroundColor` are not valid hex strings. Raises CONFLICT if a label with the same name already exists, UNAUTHORIZED if the account is not connected or lacks Gmail settings/labels scope, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if rate limits prevent creation.

name.description: The display name of the label

messageListVisibility.description: The visibility of messages with this label in the message list

labelListVisibility.description: The visibility of the label in the label list

textColor.description: The text color of the label as hex string

backgroundColor.description: The background color of the label as hex string

color.description: The color settings for the label

tool_schemas.name: delete_label
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the label with the given ID and returns a confirmation of deletion. Raises NOT_FOUND if the label ID does not exist or is not accessible, and CONFLICT if the label cannot be deleted (for example, a system label or a label currently not deletable by Gmail). Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the account is not connected or lacks Gmail settings/labels scope, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if rate limits prevent deletion.

id.description: The ID of the label to delete

tool_schemas.name: get_label
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single label by ID and returns the label resource. Raises NOT_FOUND if the label ID does not exist or is not accessible to the authenticated user. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the account is not connected or lacks Gmail settings/labels scope, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if rate limits prevent retrieval.

id.description: The ID of the label to retrieve

tool_schemas.name: list_labels
tool_schemas.description: Lists all labels in the user’s mailbox and returns the full collection (not paged), optionally including labels whose local status is deleted when `includeDeleted` is true. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the account is not connected or lacks Gmail settings/labels scope. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED if rate limits prevent listing.

includeDeleted.description: Whether to include labels whose local status is deleted

tool_schemas.name: patch_label
tool_schemas.description: Partially updates an existing label and returns the updated label resource; only provided fields are changed (name, visibility, and/or color). Raises NOT_FOUND if the label ID does not exist or is not accessible, VALIDATION_ERROR if provided enum values or color hex strings are invalid, and CONFLICT if the change is not allowed (for example, attempting to rename or modify a non-editable/system label or colliding with an existing label name). Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the account is not connected or lacks Gmail settings/labels scope, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if rate limits prevent the update.

id.description: The ID of the label to patch

name.description: The display name of the label

messageListVisibility.description: The visibility of messages with this label in the message list

labelListVisibility.description: The visibility of the label in the label list

textColor.description: The text color of the label as hex string

backgroundColor.description: The background color of the label as hex string

color.description: The color settings for the label

tool_schemas.name: update_label
tool_schemas.description: Updates the specified label’s metadata (name, list visibility, and optional color) and returns the updated label resource. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `id` is missing or any provided enum/color fields are invalid (including missing `textColor`/`backgroundColor` when `color` is provided). Raises NOT_FOUND if the label ID does not exist and FORBIDDEN if the account is not authorized to manage labels.

id.description: The ID of the label to update

name.description: The display name of the label

messageListVisibility.description: The visibility of messages with this label in the message list

labelListVisibility.description: The visibility of the label in the label list

textColor.description: The text color of the label as hex string

backgroundColor.description: The background color of the label as hex string

color.description: The color settings for the label

tool_schemas.name: batch_delete_messages
tool_schemas.description: Permanently deletes all messages identified by `ids` and returns an empty result on success. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `ids` is missing/empty or contains non-string IDs. Raises NOT_FOUND if any message ID does not exist and FORBIDDEN if the account is not authorized to delete messages.

ids.description: The IDs of the messages to delete

tool_schemas.name: batch_modify_messages
tool_schemas.description: Adds and/or removes the specified label IDs across all messages in `ids` and returns an empty result on success. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `ids` is missing/empty, if `addLabelIds`/`removeLabelIds` are not arrays of strings, or if the same label ID is present in both add and remove lists. Raises NOT_FOUND if any message ID or label ID does not exist and FORBIDDEN if the account is not authorized to modify message labels.

ids.description: The IDs of the messages to modify

addLabelIds.description: A list of label IDs to add to the messages

removeLabelIds.description: A list of label IDs to remove from the messages

tool_schemas.name: delete_message
tool_schemas.description: Immediately and permanently deletes the message identified by `id` and returns an empty result on success. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `id` is missing or not a string. Raises NOT_FOUND if the message ID does not exist and FORBIDDEN if the account is not authorized to delete messages.

id.description: The ID of the message to delete

tool_schemas.name: get_message
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single message by `id` and returns the full message resource, optionally including parsed body HTML when `includeBodyHtml` is true. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `id` is missing/invalid. Raises NOT_FOUND if the message does not exist and FORBIDDEN if the account is not authorized to read the message.

id.description: The ID of the message to retrieve

includeBodyHtml.description: Whether to include the parsed HTML in the return for each body, excluded by default because they can be excessively large

tool_schemas.name: list_messages
tool_schemas.description: Lists messages in the user’s mailbox matching optional `q`, `labelIds`, and `includeSpamTrash`, returning a page of results up to `maxResults` and a `nextPageToken` when more results are available (use `pageToken` to fetch the next page). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `maxResults` is outside 1–500, if `pageToken` is invalid, or if `labelIds` is not an array of strings. Raises NOT_FOUND if any supplied label ID does not exist and FORBIDDEN if the account is not authorized to list messages.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of messages to return. Accepts values between 1-500

pageToken.description: Page token to retrieve a specific page of results

q.description: Only return messages matching the specified query. Supports the same query format as the Gmail search box

labelIds.description: Only return messages with labels that match all of the specified label IDs

includeSpamTrash.description: Include messages from SPAM and TRASH in the results

includeBodyHtml.description: Whether to include the parsed HTML in the return for each body, excluded by default because they can be excessively large

tool_schemas.name: modify_message
tool_schemas.description: Adds and/or removes the specified label IDs on the message identified by `id` and returns the updated message resource. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `id` is missing/invalid, if label ID lists are not arrays of strings, or if the same label ID is present in both add and remove lists. Raises NOT_FOUND if the message or any referenced label ID does not exist and FORBIDDEN if the account is not authorized to modify message labels.

id.description: The ID of the message to modify

addLabelIds.description: A list of label IDs to add to the message

removeLabelIds.description: A list of label IDs to remove from the message

tool_schemas.name: send_message
tool_schemas.description: Sends an email and returns the created sent message resource; if `raw` is provided it must be a base64url-encoded RFC 2822 message and all other composition fields (`to`, `cc`, `bcc`, `subject`, `body`) are ignored, and `threadId` is used to associate the sent message to an existing thread when applicable. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither `raw` nor the minimal composed fields are provided, if `raw` is not valid base64url/RFC 2822, or if recipient fields are malformed. Raises NOT_FOUND if `threadId` is provided but does not exist and FORBIDDEN if the account is not authorized to send mail.

raw.description: The entire email message in base64url encoded RFC 2822 format, ignores params.to, cc, bcc, subject, body, includeBodyHtml if provided

threadId.description: The thread ID to associate this message with

cc.description: List of CC recipient email addresses

bcc.description: List of BCC recipient email addresses

includeBodyHtml.description: Whether to include the parsed HTML in the return for each body, excluded by default because they can be excessively large

tool_schemas.name: trash_message
tool_schemas.description: Moves the message identified by `id` to TRASH and returns the updated message resource. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `id` is missing/invalid. Raises NOT_FOUND if the message does not exist and FORBIDDEN if the account is not authorized to modify message state.

id.description: The ID of the message to move to trash

tool_schemas.name: untrash_message
tool_schemas.description: Removes the message identified by `id` from TRASH and returns the updated message resource. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `id` is missing/invalid. Raises NOT_FOUND if the message does not exist and FORBIDDEN if the account is not authorized to modify message state.

id.description: The ID of the message to remove from trash

tool_schemas.name: get_attachment
tool_schemas.description: Returns the raw attachment data for the given attachment ID from the specified message, as stored for that message in the mailbox. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if messageId or id is missing/empty, NOT_FOUND if the message does not exist or does not contain an attachment with that id, and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to read the message or attachments for the account.

messageId.description: ID of the message containing the attachment

id.description: The ID of the attachment

tool_schemas.name: delete_thread
tool_schemas.description: Permanently deletes the specified thread from the mailbox and returns the deleted thread resource (or a deletion acknowledgement) once the operation completes. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if id is missing/empty, NOT_FOUND if no thread with that id exists, and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to delete threads for the account.

id.description: The ID of the thread to delete

tool_schemas.name: get_thread
tool_schemas.description: Returns the full thread resource for the given thread ID, including its messages; when includeBodyHtml is true, each message body may include parsed HTML content in addition to other stored parts. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if id is missing/empty, NOT_FOUND if the thread does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to read the thread.

id.description: The ID of the thread to retrieve

includeBodyHtml.description: Whether to include the parsed HTML in the return for each body, excluded by default because they can be excessively large

tool_schemas.name: list_threads
tool_schemas.description: Lists threads in the user’s mailbox that match the optional Gmail query (q) and label constraints (labelIds), optionally including SPAM/TRASH, and returns a page of results plus a nextPageToken when more results are available. Pagination is controlled by maxResults and pageToken; if pageToken is provided it must be a valid token previously returned by this endpoint. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid parameter types/values (including an invalid pageToken), and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to list threads for the account.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of threads to return

pageToken.description: Page token to retrieve a specific page of results

q.description: Only return threads matching the specified query

labelIds.description: Only return threads with labels that match all of the specified label IDs

includeSpamTrash.description: Include threads from SPAM and TRASH in the results

includeBodyHtml.description: Whether to include the parsed HTML in the return for each body, excluded by default because they can be excessively large

tool_schemas.name: modify_thread
tool_schemas.description: Applies label changes to the specified thread by adding addLabelIds and/or removing removeLabelIds and returns the updated thread resource. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if id is missing/empty or if label IDs are malformed, NOT_FOUND if the thread does not exist, CONFLICT if the requested label modifications cannot be applied in the thread’s current state, and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to modify labels on the thread.

id.description: The ID of the thread to modify

addLabelIds.description: A list of label IDs to add to the thread

removeLabelIds.description: A list of label IDs to remove from the thread

tool_schemas.name: trash_thread
tool_schemas.description: Moves the specified thread to TRASH and returns the updated thread resource reflecting the trash state. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if id is missing/empty, NOT_FOUND if the thread does not exist, CONFLICT if the thread is already in TRASH or cannot be trashed in its current state, and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to trash threads.

id.description: The ID of the thread to move to trash

tool_schemas.name: untrash_thread
tool_schemas.description: Removes the specified thread from TRASH and returns the updated thread resource reflecting the restored state. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if id is missing/empty, NOT_FOUND if the thread does not exist, CONFLICT if the thread is not currently in TRASH or cannot be untrashed in its current state, and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to untrash threads.

id.description: The ID of the thread to remove from trash

tool_schemas.name: get_auto_forwarding
tool_schemas.description: Returns the account’s auto-forwarding configuration, including whether forwarding is enabled and where messages are forwarded. Raises FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to read mailbox settings for the account.

tool_schemas.name: get_imap
tool_schemas.description: Returns the account’s IMAP configuration, including enablement and relevant IMAP behavior settings. Raises FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to read mailbox settings for the account.

tool_schemas.name: get_language
tool_schemas.description: Returns the account’s language/locale preference used for Gmail settings and UI behavior where applicable. Raises FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to read mailbox settings for the account.

tool_schemas.name: get_pop
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves the current POP access settings for the authenticated user and returns the POP configuration (e.g., access window and post-fetch disposition). Raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller lacks permission to read mailbox settings, and NOT_FOUND if the user’s POP settings resource is unavailable.

tool_schemas.name: get_vacation
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves the current vacation responder configuration for the authenticated user and returns the vacation settings (enabled state, dates, scope restrictions, and response content). Raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller lacks permission to read mailbox settings, and NOT_FOUND if the vacation settings resource is unavailable.

tool_schemas.name: update_auto_forwarding
tool_schemas.description: Updates the account’s automatic forwarding configuration and returns the updated forwarding settings. Validates that enabled, emailAddress, and disposition are provided and that disposition is one of leaveInInbox, archive, trash, or markRead; raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid fields. Raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller cannot manage mailbox settings and CONFLICT if forwarding cannot be enabled for the specified address/state (for example, when the target address is not eligible for forwarding).

enabled.description: Whether all incoming mail is automatically forwarded to another address

emailAddress.description: Email address to which messages should be automatically forwarded

disposition.description: The state in which messages should be left after being forwarded

tool_schemas.name: update_imap
tool_schemas.description: Updates IMAP access settings for the account and returns the updated IMAP configuration. Validates enabled is provided, and when present validates expungeBehavior is one of archive, trash, or deleteForever and maxFolderSize is a number; raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid values. Raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller cannot manage mailbox settings and CONFLICT if the requested IMAP state/change is not permitted for the account.

enabled.description: Whether IMAP is enabled for the account

expungeBehavior.description: The action that will be executed on a message when it is marked as deleted and expunged from the last visible IMAP folder

maxFolderSize.description: An optional limit on the number of messages that can be accessed through IMAP

tool_schemas.name: update_language
tool_schemas.description: Sets the account display language and returns the updated language configuration. Validates displayLanguage is provided and is formatted as an RFC 3066 language tag; raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid tags. Raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller cannot manage mailbox settings and NOT_FOUND if the language settings resource is unavailable.

displayLanguage.description: The language to display Gmail in, formatted as an RFC 3066 Language Tag

tool_schemas.name: update_pop
tool_schemas.description: Updates POP access settings for the account and returns the updated POP configuration. Validates accessWindow is one of disabled, allMail, or fromNowOn and disposition is one of archive, trash, or leaveInInbox; raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid fields. Raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller cannot manage mailbox settings and CONFLICT if the requested POP state/change is not permitted for the account.

accessWindow.description: The range of messages which are accessible via POP

disposition.description: The action that will be executed on a message after it has been fetched via POP

tool_schemas.name: update_vacation
tool_schemas.description: Updates vacation responder settings and returns the updated vacation configuration. Validates enableAutoReply and responseBodyPlainText are provided, and when present validates startTime/endTime are epoch-millisecond strings with endTime not earlier than startTime; raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid fields. Raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller cannot manage mailbox settings and CONFLICT if the requested responder state/timing/scope is not permitted for the account.

enableAutoReply.description: Whether the vacation responder is enabled

responseSubject.description: Optional subject line for the vacation responder auto-reply

responseBodyPlainText.description: Response body in plain text format

restrictToContacts.description: Whether responses are only sent to contacts

restrictToDomain.description: Whether responses are only sent to users in the same domain

startTime.description: Start time for sending auto-replies (epoch ms)

endTime.description: End time for sending auto-replies (epoch ms)

tool_schemas.name: add_delegate
tool_schemas.description: Adds the specified delegate to the authenticated user’s mailbox delegation list and returns the created delegate entry. Validates delegateEmail is provided and is a syntactically valid email address; raises VALIDATION_ERROR otherwise. Raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller cannot manage delegates, and CONFLICT if the delegate already exists or cannot be added for this account/domain policy.

delegateEmail.description: Email address of delegate to add

tool_schemas.name: remove_delegate
tool_schemas.description: Removes the specified delegate from the authenticated user’s mailbox delegation list and returns a confirmation of removal. Validates delegateEmail is provided and is a syntactically valid email address; raises VALIDATION_ERROR otherwise. Raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller cannot manage delegates, and NOT_FOUND if no delegate with that email exists on the account.

delegateEmail.description: Email address of delegate to remove

tool_schemas.name: get_delegate
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single delegate entry by email and returns the delegate configuration/status for the authenticated user. Validates delegateEmail is provided and is a syntactically valid email address; raises VALIDATION_ERROR otherwise. Raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller cannot read delegates, and NOT_FOUND if the delegate does not exist on the account.

delegateEmail.description: The email address of the delegate to retrieve

tool_schemas.name: list_delegates
tool_schemas.description: Lists delegate relationships for the authenticated account and returns the delegates array; results are not paginated. Set includeDeleted to also return delegates whose local status is deleted. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the user is not authenticated, FORBIDDEN if mailbox settings access is not permitted, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the account has exceeded allowed settings operations.

includeDeleted.description: Whether to include delegates whose local status is deleted

tool_schemas.name: create_filter
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new Gmail message filter using the provided criteria and action and returns the created filter resource. This endpoint is not paginated. Raises INVALID_ARGUMENT if criteria or action is missing/invalid (including malformed query/negatedQuery, invalid sizeComparison, or invalid label ids in addLabelIds/removeLabelIds), CONFLICT if the filter cannot be created due to an existing conflicting configuration, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing or insufficient permissions, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the account has reached its filter or settings write limits.

from.description: The sender's display name or email address

to.description: The recipient's display name or email address

subject.description: Case-insensitive phrase in the message's subject

query.description: A Gmail search query that specifies the filter's criteria

negatedQuery.description: A Gmail search query that specifies criteria the message must not match

hasAttachment.description: Whether the message has any attachment

excludeChats.description: Whether the response should exclude chats

size.description: The size of the entire RFC822 message in bytes

sizeComparison.description: How the message size in bytes should be in relation to the size field

addLabelIds.description: List of labels to add to messages

removeLabelIds.description: List of labels to remove from messages

forward.description: Email address that the message should be forwarded to

action.description: Actions to perform on messages matching the criteria

tool_schemas.name: delete_filter
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the filter identified by id and returns an empty success response. This endpoint is not paginated. Raises NOT_FOUND if no filter with the given id exists (or it is not visible to the caller), UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing or insufficient permissions, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the account is rate-limited for settings mutations.

id.description: The ID of the filter to be deleted

tool_schemas.name: get_filter
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves the filter resource identified by id and returns it. This endpoint is not paginated. Raises NOT_FOUND if the filter id does not exist (or is not accessible), UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing or insufficient permissions, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the account is rate-limited for settings reads.

id.description: The ID of the filter to be fetched

tool_schemas.name: list_filters
tool_schemas.description: Lists the account’s message filters and returns the full collection; results are not paginated. Set includeDeleted to also return filters whose local status is deleted. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the user is not authenticated, FORBIDDEN if mailbox settings access is not permitted, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when settings read limits are exceeded.

includeDeleted.description: Whether to include filters whose local status is deleted

tool_schemas.name: create_forwarding_address
tool_schemas.description: Creates a forwarding address entry for the account using forwardingEmail and returns the created forwarding address resource. This endpoint is not paginated. Raises INVALID_ARGUMENT if forwardingEmail is missing or not a valid email address, CONFLICT if the forwarding address already exists, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing or insufficient permissions, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the account has exceeded forwarding/settings write limits.

forwardingEmail.description: An email address to which messages can be forwarded

tool_schemas.name: delete_forwarding_address
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the forwarding address identified by forwardingEmail and returns an empty success response. This endpoint is not paginated. Raises NOT_FOUND if the forwarding address does not exist, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing or insufficient permissions, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the account is rate-limited for settings mutations.

forwardingEmail.description: The forwarding address to be deleted

tool_schemas.name: get_forwarding_address
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves the forwarding address identified by forwardingEmail and returns its resource. This endpoint is not paginated. Raises NOT_FOUND if the forwarding address does not exist, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing or insufficient permissions, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the account is rate-limited for settings reads.

forwardingEmail.description: The forwarding address to be retrieved

tool_schemas.name: list_forwarding_addresses
tool_schemas.description: Lists forwarding addresses for the account and returns a page of results along with nextPageToken when more results are available; use maxResults for page size and pageToken to fetch subsequent pages. If pageToken is omitted, the first page is returned. Raises INVALID_ARGUMENT for an invalid pageToken or maxResults, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing or insufficient permissions, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when settings read limits are exceeded.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of forwarding addresses to return (page size).

pageToken.description: Token identifying which result page to return.

tool_schemas.name: create_send_as
tool_schemas.description: Creates a custom send-as alias using sendAsEmail and optional fields and returns the created send-as resource. This endpoint is not paginated. Raises INVALID_ARGUMENT if sendAsEmail is missing/invalid or if provided fields are not valid for a send-as configuration, CONFLICT if an alias with the same sendAsEmail already exists or conflicts with account configuration, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing or insufficient permissions, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the account has exceeded send-as/settings write limits.

sendAsEmail.description: The email address that appears in the 'From:' header

displayName.description: A name that appears in the 'From:' header

replyToAddress.description: An optional email address that is included in a 'Reply-To:' header

isPrimary.description: Whether this address is the primary address

treatAsAlias.description: Whether Gmail should treat this address as an alias

tool_schemas.name: delete_send_as
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the specified send-as alias from the account and returns an empty success response. Raises INVALID_ARGUMENT if sendAsEmail is missing or malformed, PERMISSION_DENIED if the caller is not authorized to manage send-as settings, and NOT_FOUND if no send-as alias exists for the given sendAsEmail. Raises FAILED_PRECONDITION if the alias cannot be deleted because it is the account’s primary send-as address or otherwise not in a deletable state.

sendAsEmail.description: The send-as alias to be deleted

tool_schemas.name: get_send_as
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves the current configuration for the specified send-as alias and returns the send-as resource. Raises INVALID_ARGUMENT if sendAsEmail is missing or malformed, PERMISSION_DENIED if the caller is not authorized to view send-as settings, and NOT_FOUND if the alias does not exist. Raises UNAVAILABLE if the backing Gmail data cannot be reached at request time.

sendAsEmail.description: The send-as alias to be retrieved

tool_schemas.name: list_send_as
tool_schemas.description: Lists send-as aliases configured on the account and returns a page of send-as resources; use maxResults as the page size and pageToken to fetch subsequent pages from the returned nextPageToken. Raises INVALID_ARGUMENT if maxResults is non-positive or pageToken is invalid, and PERMISSION_DENIED if the caller is not authorized to list send-as settings. Raises UNAVAILABLE if the backing Gmail data cannot be reached at request time.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of send-as aliases to return (page size).

pageToken.description: Token identifying which result page to return.

tool_schemas.name: patch_send_as
tool_schemas.description: Partially updates fields on the specified send-as alias (only the provided fields are changed) and returns the updated send-as resource. Raises INVALID_ARGUMENT if sendAsEmail is missing/malformed or if any provided field value fails validation, PERMISSION_DENIED if the caller is not authorized to modify send-as settings, and NOT_FOUND if the alias does not exist. Raises FAILED_PRECONDITION if the requested update is not allowed (for example, attempting to set isPrimary in a way that violates allowed primary/alias rules).

sendAsEmail.description: The send-as alias to be updated

displayName.description: A name that appears in the 'From:' header

replyToAddress.description: An optional email address that is included in a 'Reply-To:' header

isPrimary.description: Whether this address is the primary address

treatAsAlias.description: Whether Gmail should treat this address as an alias

tool_schemas.name: update_send_as
tool_schemas.description: Replaces the editable configuration of the specified send-as alias with the provided values and returns the updated send-as resource. Raises INVALID_ARGUMENT if sendAsEmail is missing/malformed or if any provided field value fails validation, PERMISSION_DENIED if the caller is not authorized to modify send-as settings, and NOT_FOUND if the alias does not exist. Raises FAILED_PRECONDITION if the requested update is not allowed (for example, an invalid primary/alias state transition).

sendAsEmail.description: The send-as alias to be updated

displayName.description: A name that appears in the 'From:' header

replyToAddress.description: An optional email address that is included in a 'Reply-To:' header

isPrimary.description: Whether this address is the primary address

treatAsAlias.description: Whether Gmail should treat this address as an alias

tool_schemas.name: verify_send_as
tool_schemas.description: Sends a verification email for the specified send-as alias and returns an empty success response when the verification workflow is initiated. Raises INVALID_ARGUMENT if sendAsEmail is missing or malformed, PERMISSION_DENIED if the caller is not authorized to manage send-as settings, and NOT_FOUND if the alias does not exist. Raises FAILED_PRECONDITION if the alias is already verified or cannot be verified in its current state, and RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED if verification requests are rate-limited.

sendAsEmail.description: The send-as alias to be verified

tool_schemas.name: delete_smime_info
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the S/MIME configuration identified by id for the specified send-as alias and returns an empty success response. Raises INVALID_ARGUMENT if sendAsEmail or id is missing/malformed, PERMISSION_DENIED if the caller is not authorized to manage S/MIME settings, and NOT_FOUND if the send-as alias or S/MIME config id does not exist. Raises FAILED_PRECONDITION if the config cannot be deleted due to its current usage/state.

sendAsEmail.description: The email address that appears in the 'From:' header

id.description: The immutable ID for the S/MIME config

tool_schemas.name: get_smime_info
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves the S/MIME configuration identified by id for the specified send-as alias and returns the S/MIME config resource. Raises INVALID_ARGUMENT if sendAsEmail or id is missing/malformed, PERMISSION_DENIED if the caller is not authorized to view S/MIME settings, and NOT_FOUND if the send-as alias or S/MIME config id does not exist. Raises UNAVAILABLE if the backing Gmail data cannot be reached at request time.

sendAsEmail.description: The email address that appears in the 'From:' header

id.description: The immutable ID for the S/MIME config

tool_schemas.name: insert_smime_info
tool_schemas.description: Uploads and creates a new S/MIME configuration for the specified send-as alias using the provided pkcs12 material and encryptedKeyPassword, and returns the created S/MIME config resource. Raises INVALID_ARGUMENT if required fields are missing, pkcs12 is not valid PKCS#12, or the password/certificate material fails validation, and PERMISSION_DENIED if the caller is not authorized to manage S/MIME settings. Raises NOT_FOUND if the send-as alias does not exist, CONFLICT if an equivalent S/MIME config already exists for the alias, and RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED if write quotas are exceeded.

sendAsEmail.description: The email address that appears in the 'From:' header

pkcs12.description: PKCS#12 format containing a single private/public key pair and certificate chain

tool_schemas.name: list_smime_info
tool_schemas.description: Lists all S/MIME configurations for the specified send-as alias and returns the collection of S/MIME config resources (this endpoint is not paged). Raises INVALID_ARGUMENT if sendAsEmail is missing or malformed, PERMISSION_DENIED if the caller is not authorized to view S/MIME settings, and NOT_FOUND if the send-as alias does not exist. Raises UNAVAILABLE if the backing Gmail data cannot be reached at request time.

sendAsEmail.description: The email address that appears in the 'From:' header

tool_schemas.name: set_default_smime_info
tool_schemas.description: Sets the default S/MIME configuration used by the specified send-as alias by selecting the S/MIME config identified by id, and returns the updated send-as/S/MIME state for that alias. Raises INVALID_ARGUMENT if sendAsEmail or id is missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the send-as alias does not exist or the S/MIME config id is not present for that alias, and CONFLICT if the S/MIME config cannot be set as default due to the alias/config state. Raises PERMISSION_DENIED if the caller is not authorized to manage send-as settings for the account, and RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED if request or sync quotas are exceeded.

sendAsEmail.description: The email address that appears in the 'From:' header

id.description: The immutable ID for the S/MIME config

tool_schemas.name: get_profile
tool_schemas.description: Returns the current user’s Gmail profile information (such as email address and mailbox history ID) as a single profile object. Raises PERMISSION_DENIED if the caller is not authorized to access the mailbox profile, and UNAUTHENTICATED if no valid credentials are available. Raises RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED if read quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: watch_mailbox
tool_schemas.description: Creates or replaces a Gmail push notification watch that publishes mailbox change notifications to the specified Cloud Pub/Sub topic, and returns the watch response (including the new history ID and expiration). If labelIds is provided, notifications are filtered according to labelFilterAction (include/exclude); this endpoint does not page results. Raises INVALID_ARGUMENT if topicName is missing/invalid, if labelFilterAction is not compatible with labelIds, or if any label ID is malformed, NOT_FOUND if any specified labelId does not exist, and PERMISSION_DENIED if the caller lacks permission to start a watch or to publish to the topic; raises RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED if watch or request quotas are exceeded.

topicName.description: The name of the Cloud Pub/Sub topic to publish notifications to

labelIds.description: Label IDs to restrict notifications to

labelFilterAction.description: Whether to include or exclude the specified labels

tool_schemas.name: stop_mail_watch
tool_schemas.description: Stops the currently active push notification watch for the user’s mailbox and returns an empty success response. Raises PERMISSION_DENIED if the caller is not authorized to manage mailbox watches and UNAUTHENTICATED if no valid credentials are available. Raises RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED if request quotas are exceeded.

metadata.name: Gmail MCP
metadata.description: This backend stores a local, queryable representation of a user’s Gmail mailbox and settings, synchronized from Gmail and mutated via tools that mirror Gmail API actions (drafts/messages/threads/labels and mailbox settings).
